notes: Collection 9 is NOT anatomy: it is skin surface patches (thin solidified shells with Skin-N materials, volumes ~1e-5 to 3e-4 m3) delineating surface-anatomy regions, plus hair/nails/eyelashes, label text and anchors
Surface patches lie over the skin so they overlap the body surface; skin itself is not in collections 1-4 audit (no name overlaps)
No data shared with collections 1-4
